result.title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
result.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 10th IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (IEEE EI2 2026). IEEE Xplore publication pending
result.summary: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-customer extrapolation, while their new-customer benefits vary by model. These findings suggest regime-matched error budgets, limited target supervision for model adaptation in new regions, and use-case-dependent context selection for energy data analytics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究从净智能电表数据中拆分出户用光伏发电，在 Ausgrid 与 Pecan Street 数据上用固定训练协议和四类部署情景（已知/新用户、未来时段、新区域）对比若干深度序列架构，发现部署情景比模型选择更能解释误差，并显示少量目标区域家庭微调可显著降低迁移误差、长输入窗口的收益依赖情景与模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属能源时序领域、与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「情景匹配的误差预算」与输入窗口长度收益在已知/新实体间的分化分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态沿长度、深度和跨域迁移的评测框架与上下文长度选择提供参考，可供核查。
